data.name: Hotel Krystal Cancún
data.address: Blvd. Kukulcan Km 8.5-Km. 9 Lotes 9 y 9A, Punta Cancun, Zona Hotelera, 77500 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Set in the Punta Cancun resort area along the Caribbean Sea, this informal beachfront hotel with more than 500 guest quarters is 25 km from Cancun International Airport.
Relaxed rooms offer Wi-Fi, TVs and safes. Upgraded rooms add minifridges, balconies and/or sea views. Suites feature microwaves and sofabeds. Club rooms and suites have private lounge access with snacks and drinks. Room service is available 24/7.
Amenities include a gym and a spa, plus an outdoor pool and a private area on the beach. There are also 8 bars and eateries, along with a kids' club, regular entertainment and breakfast.
